title: sigelo/0 shared definitions
description: Building blocks for the sigelo/0 object schemas (SPEC §2, §3, §3.1). The host in $id is a placeholder (.invalid) until the project domain is chosen. Patterns are ECMA-262 regular expressions evaluated with Unicode semantics (the 'u' flag): #/$defs/string relies on it to refuse a lone surrogate while accepting a surrogate PAIR as one character. What JSON Schema cannot express, and a verifier must still check: duplicate keys (a parse-time rule, SPEC §3), exp > iat, a rotation's next != id, every signature, DID-hash and chain rule, and each payment method's own address and sig_addr checks.

string.description: A JSON string of Unicode scalar values that are not noncharacters: no lone surrogate, no U+FDD0..U+FDEF, no U+xFFFE / U+xFFFF in any plane (SPEC §3.1, I-JSON).

key.description: An object key: no lone surrogate, never __proto__ (SPEC §3.1).

int.description: An integer in ±(2^53−1) (SPEC §3). Floats, exponents and larger integers are malformed.

jcsValue.description: Anything JCS can serialize under SPEC §3: null, booleans, integers in range, strings without lone surrogates, and arrays and objects of the same, at any depth.

unixSeconds.description: iat / exp: Unix seconds, an integer in [0, 2^53−1] (SPEC §3.1). exp > iat is required too but is not expressible here.

multibase.description: Multibase base58btc: 'z' then the Bitcoin base58 alphabet (SPEC §2).

nonce.description: A nonce (genesis, binding, invoice): multibase z + base58btc, 1 to 63 digits, so at most 64 characters (SPEC §2). The §5.2 challenge nonce is exempt: opaque, the world's choice.

publicKey.description: An Ed25519 public key: multibase of multicodec 0xed01 plus 32 raw bytes, which always spells z6Mk plus 44 characters (SPEC §2).

signature.description: An Ed25519 signature on the wire: multibase of the 64 raw bytes, no multicodec prefix (SPEC §2).

did.description: did:sigelo: + multibase of the raw 32-byte SHA-256 of the JCS genesis (SPEC §2, §4).

commitment.description: A recovery commitment: sha256: + lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte recovery public key (SPEC §4).

created.description: RFC 3339 UTC, exactly YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ: uppercase T and Z, no fraction, no offset, seconds 00-59 (no leap second), and a real Gregorian date (SPEC §4). The day-of-month limit (30 April, 29 February in leap years only) is checked by the verifiers but is not expressed here.

atomicUnits.description: A non-negative decimal integer as a string, no sign, no fraction, no leading zeros (SPEC §6.3).
